# Telemetry capability matrix

Authoritative telemetry collection path per signal for every compute architecture (catalog/architecture-matrix.yaml) and database family. Consistent with ADR-0001 section 10: Fluent Bit for application logs; Datadog Agent OTLP (AKS/VM) or the OTel gateway (managed runtimes) for traces/metrics; Datadog Azure integration for platform metrics; diagnostic settings (obs-diagnostics) for platform logs; Agent DBM checks from the observability subnet.

Verified 2026-10-09. Each cell: support / method / owner component.

### Duplicate prevention and Datadog limitations (compute)

| Architecture | Signal | Duplicate prevention | Datadog limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aks` | app_logs | Datadog Agent DD_LOGS_ENABLED=false / containerCollectAll=false | none |
| `aks` | traces | no dd-trace; no separate collector | none |
| `aks` | app_metrics | single exporter | none |
| `aks` | runtime_metrics | dd-trace runtime metrics off | none |
| `aks` | platform_metrics | single Azure integration per subscription; do not also enable Azure Monitor metric export to Datadog | Azure Monitor latency (typically several minutes); metric granularity 1 min |
| `aks` | platform_logs | not application logs | none |
| `aks` | profiling | profiler only; tracing stays on OTel SDK (DD_TRACE_ENABLED=false when profiler is used) | profiling requires the Datadog library; OTel profiling signal not used |
| `container-apps-consumption` | app_logs | ContainerAppConsoleLogs are NOT exported by diagnostic settings; Datadog serverless-init log collection unused | sidecar adds CPU/memory to each replica |
| `container-apps-consumption` | traces | no serverless-init / dd-trace | OTel Collector azure resource detection only supports VMs; set cloud.provider=azure, cloud.platform, cloud.resource_id via OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES |
| `container-apps-consumption` | app_metrics | single exporter | OTel Collector azure resource detection only supports VMs; set cloud.provider=azure, cloud.platform, cloud.resource_id via OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES |
| `container-apps-consumption` | runtime_metrics | dd-trace runtime metrics off | no host-level metrics (no Agent) |
| `container-apps-consumption` | platform_metrics | single Azure integration per subscription; do not also enable Azure Monitor metric export to Datadog | Azure Monitor latency (typically several minutes); metric granularity 1 min |
| `container-apps-consumption` | platform_logs | system logs only | none |
| `container-apps-consumption` | profiling | profiler only; tracing stays on OTel SDK (DD_TRACE_ENABLED=false when profiler is used) | profiling requires the Datadog library; OTel profiling signal not used |
| `container-apps-dedicated` | app_logs | ContainerAppConsoleLogs are NOT exported by diagnostic settings; Datadog serverless-init log collection unused | sidecar adds CPU/memory to each replica |
| `container-apps-dedicated` | traces | no serverless-init / dd-trace | OTel Collector azure resource detection only supports VMs; set cloud.provider=azure, cloud.platform, cloud.resource_id via OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES |
| `container-apps-dedicated` | app_metrics | single exporter | OTel Collector azure resource detection only supports VMs; set cloud.provider=azure, cloud.platform, cloud.resource_id via OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES |
| `container-apps-dedicated` | runtime_metrics | dd-trace runtime metrics off | no host-level metrics (no Agent) |
| `container-apps-dedicated` | platform_metrics | single Azure integration per subscription; do not also enable Azure Monitor metric export to Datadog | Azure Monitor latency (typically several minutes); metric granularity 1 min |
| `container-apps-dedicated` | platform_logs | system logs only | none |

### Database Monitoring limitations

| Database | DBM | Limitation |
|---|---|---|
| `sql-database-provisioned` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-database-serverless` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-elastic-pool` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-hyperscale` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-managed-instance` | yes | Agent runs on a separate host (no host access); connect directly to the MI host name |
| `sql-server-on-vm` | yes | self-hosted setup guide applies |
| `postgresql-flexible` | yes | Agent 7.36.1+; azure.extensions=pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_statements.track=ALL, track_activity_query_size=4096 (static, restart) |
| `postgresql-elastic-cluster` | partial | Elastic clusters are not listed in Datadog's Azure Postgres DBM page; worker nodes share one IP with different ports (7000+), per-node DBM unverified |
| `mysql-flexible` | partial | performance_schema=ON (restart); Query Activity and Wait Event collection are NOT supported on Flexible Server |
| `cosmos-nosql` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-mongodb-ru` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-cassandra` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-gremlin` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-table` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `documentdb` | no | Datadog MongoDB DBM supports self-hosted MongoDB and MongoDB Atlas only |
| `managed-cassandra` | no | Cassandra is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix; the Datadog Cassandra (JMX) integration needs host access, which the managed service does not give |
| `managed-redis` | no | Redis is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `table-storage` | no | not a database engine supported by DBM |
| `confidential-ledger` | no | not a DBM engine |
| `horizondb` | no | PostgreSQL-compatible; a postgres Agent check may connect but is unsupported |
| `data-explorer` | n/a | n/a |
| `ai-search` | n/a | n/a |
| `blob-storage` | n/a | n/a |
| `adls-gen2` | n/a | n/a |
| `synapse-sql` | no | n/a |
| `azure-cache-for-redis` | no | Redis is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-postgresql` | no | n/a |

## Verified findings

- **dbm_support**
  - azure_sql_database: supported (deployment_type sql_database; one instance per database; elastic pool DBs are separate hosts; no Agent Jobs; autodiscovery unsupported); Agent 7.41.0+
  - azure_sql_managed_instance: supported (Agent on a separate host)
  - sql_server_on_azure_vm: supported (self-hosted guide, Agent on the VM); SQL Server 2025 needs Agent 7.79+
  - postgresql_flexible_server: supported (Agent 7.36.1+; pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_statements.track=ALL, track_activity_query_size=4096); elastic clusters and Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL not listed
  - mysql_flexible_server: partially supported - Query Activity and Wait Event collection NOT supported on Flexible Server; performance_schema=ON
  - not_supported: Cosmos DB (all APIs), Azure DocumentDB (Datadog MongoDB DBM covers self-hosted + Atlas only), Managed Redis / Azure Cache for Redis, Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra, Table Storage, Confidential Ledger, HorizonDB, Synapse, Data Explorer
- **serverless_otlp_intake**: Datadog accepts agentless OTLP from Azure Container Apps, App Service and Functions: http/protobuf or http/json only (gRPC NOT supported); headers dd-api-key, dd-otlp-source=serverless, compute_stats=true; set OTEL_SERVICE_NAME; set cloud.provider=azure, cloud.platform (azure.container_apps \| azure.app_service \| azure.functions) and cloud.resource_id because the Collector's Azure resource detector only supports VMs. Lab default remains the private OTel gateway; direct intake is the fallback for runtimes without VNet integration (Windows Consumption).
- **functions_native**: Datadog native Functions APM: Dedicated/Premium/Consumption/Flex (Flex needs DD_AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP), via Serverless Compatibility Layer + tracer (or .NET APM extension on Windows Dedicated/Premium); profiler preview for Python/Node only. Not used by default (OTel path is authoritative).
- **app_service_native**: Datadog App Service instrumentation: Linux code, Linux container, Windows code (Java/Node/.NET); Windows containers not listed. Not used by default.
- **container_apps_native**: Datadog serverless-init (in-container or sidecar) gives traces, enhanced metrics (azure.app_containerapps.enhanced.*), custom metrics and logs. Not used by default.
